title: Reducedness is local for smooth maps of algebraic spaces
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $f:X\to Y$ a smooth morphism of algebraic spaces over $S$ [def-trf-algebraic-space]. Smoothness is tested on etale scheme charts using [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms]. An algebraic space is reduced if its etale scheme charts are reduced, meaning that all their local rings have no nonzero nilpotents. If $Y$ is reduced, then $X$ is reduced. If $f$ is surjective on underlying field-valued point classes [def-a1-space-point-topology] and $X$ is reduced, then $Y$ is reduced.

proof.text: First establish the scheme ascent implication. Let $h:T\to W$ be a smooth map of schemes and suppose $W$ reduced. For each $t\in T$, take smooth affine charts $\operatorname{Spec}B\subset T$, $\operatorname{Spec}A\subset W$ around $t,h(t)$, with image in the latter. By [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms], smoothness is affine-locally smoothness of $A\to B$. The ring $A$ is reduced by [def-pc-reduced-scheme], so [lem-sfb-smooth-algebra-over-reduced-ring] gives that $B$ is reduced. These neighbourhoods cover $T$, and their reduced local rings are the local rings of $T$. Thus $T$ is reduced. This applies in particular to etale scheme maps in the sense of [def-weil-etale-morphism], used for the charts of [def-trf-algebraic-space]: they are smooth by [lem-weil-pbc-etale-smooth-zero-dimensional-fibres].

source.place: Tags 033B (lemma-reduced-goes-up), 00TA (lemma-smooth-syntomic), 00HT (lemma-flat-localization), 00HR (lemma-local-flat-ff), 05CK (lemma-faithfully-flat-universally-injective); scheme localization of descent.tex Tag 034E (lemma-reduced-local-smooth).

proof.text: Next establish scheme descent for a surjective smooth $h:T\to W$ with $T$ reduced. For $w\in W$, choose $t$ over $w$ and smooth affine charts $A\to B$ as in step 1. Smoothness gives flatness by [lem-weil-pbc-smooth-ring-map-flat]. The map $\mathcal O_{W,w}\to\mathcal O_{T,t}$ is flat and local by [lem-weil-pbc-flat-local-ring-maps], hence faithfully flat by [lem-weil-pbc-flat-local-hom-faithfully-flat]. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-faithfully-flat-universally-injective] with $N=\mathcal O_{W,w}$; under $N\otimes_N\mathcal O_{T,t}\cong\mathcal O_{T,t}$ it says this ring map is injective. A nilpotent in $\mathcal O_{W,w}$ maps to zero in the reduced ring $\mathcal O_{T,t}$ and is therefore zero. Every target local ring is reduced, which proves descent, also for a surjective etale map. No quasi-compactness is used.

source.place: Tags 033B (lemma-reduced-goes-up), 00TA (lemma-smooth-syntomic), 00HT (lemma-flat-localization), 00HR (lemma-local-flat-ff), 05CK (lemma-faithfully-flat-universally-injective); scheme localization of descent.tex Tag 034E (lemma-reduced-local-smooth).

proof.text: The definition of reducedness in the item can now be tested on one atlas. For an algebraic space $Z$, let $a:W\to Z$ be a surjective etale scheme atlas. If $Z$ is reduced then $W$ is reduced by definition. Conversely suppose $W$ reduced and take any etale scheme chart $b:T\to Z$. By [lem-trf-space-fibre-products-etale-covers], $P=W\times_Z T$ is a scheme and $P\to T$ is surjective etale. Its other projection $P\to W$ is the scheme base change of the representable etale map $T\to Z$ along $W\to Z$, hence etale by the definition of representable etale maps in [def-trf-algebraic-space]. Step 1 makes $P$ reduced, and step 2 makes $T$ reduced. This proves reducedness of every chart, hence of $Z$. For representable $Z$ the identity chart shows that this agrees with scheme reducedness.

source.place: Tag 03E8 (lemma-type-property), proof applied to reducedness, and section-types-properties, reduced entry in remark-list-properties-local-etale-topology.

proof.text: Choose a surjective etale scheme atlas $V\to Y$. The space $X_V=X\times_YV$ exists by [lem-trf-space-fibre-products-etale-covers] and has a surjective etale scheme atlas $U\to X_V$ by [def-trf-algebraic-space]. The map $X_V\to X$ is surjective etale by base change, so $U\to X$ is etale and surjective by [lem-trf-space-chartwise-etale-permanence]. Write $g:U\to V$ for the composite. Smoothness is etale local on source and target for schemes by [lem-sfb-scheme-etale-source-target-properties]. Apply [lem-sfb-space-etale-presentation-property-criterion] with this property to the presentation square $U\to V$, $X\to Y$: because $f$ is smooth, $g$ is smooth.

source.place: Tag 0GB3 (lemma-reduced-local-smooth), construction of U,V; spaces-morphisms.tex Tag 03ZF (lemma-smooth-local), condition (7). Implementation of smooth chart test through Tags 03MJ and 04R3.

proof.text: If $Y$ is reduced, then its chart $V$ is reduced. Step 1 applied to the smooth scheme morphism $g:U\to V$ gives that $U$ is reduced. Since $U\to X$ is the surjective etale atlas of step 4, step 3 gives that $X$ is reduced. This proves the first assertion. For the empty source the same conclusion is vacuous.

source.place: Tag 0GB3 (lemma-reduced-local-smooth), first assertion after choosing charts.

proof.text: Assume now that $f$ is surjective and $X$ reduced. The surjectivity base-change clause of [lem-sfb-space-smooth-surjective-fppf-locality] gives that $X_V\to V$ is surjective on field-valued point classes. Since $U\to X_V$ is surjective, so is $g:U\to V$; images compose as functions on point classes, and for schemes these are the ordinary scheme points. The chart $U$ is reduced by reducedness of $X$. Scheme descent (step 2) along the smooth surjection $g$ gives that $V$ is reduced; the atlas test (step 3) gives that $Y$ is reduced. The empty-source case forces $Y$ empty by surjectivity.

source.place: Tag 0GB3 (lemma-reduced-local-smooth), last sentence, and spaces-morphisms.tex Tag 03MH (lemma-base-change-surjective).
